remarks: Owner will consider all offers between $265,000–$315,000 or more on this well-loved brick ranch in West Seneca — and wait until you step out back. This is the kind of backyard people build their summers around, with a new concrete patio under a hardcover awning, a hot tub (negotiable) for cool fall evenings, and plenty of room to spread out on this nearly quarter-acre corner lot. Picture weekend cookouts in the shade, string lights overhead, and a relaxing soak under the stars.  Inside, single-floor living makes everyday life easy. The bright living room flows into a spacious eat-in kitchen with a pantry and gas range, with room for a full dining table and classic oak cabinetry and a dishwasher. A 24x14 four-season room with sliding doors connects the home to the patio, making it a natural gathering spot all year long. It's versatile, too — it can double as a large mudroom and offers space for first-floor laundry.  All three bedrooms are on the main floor, and the bedrooms feature new flooring. New ceiling fans and light fixtures add a fresh, updated feel throughout. A full bath upstairs plus a half bath in the basement add everyday convenience.  The big-ticket items have been taken care of, which means peace of mind for the next owner. The roof was replaced in 2019, and a newer sump pump was installed in 2023. Central air and gas heat keep you comfortable in every season.  Need more space? The full, partially finished basement offers a rec room ready for movie nights, a hobby space, or a home gym, along with laundry and plenty of storage. The attached 1.5-car garage handles your vehicles, bikes, and seasonal gear, and the rebuilt 36x12 shed with built-in shelving is a dream for tools, patio furniture, lawn equipment, or a workshop setup.  Located in the West Seneca school district with easy access to shopping, dining, and major routes, this home offers comfort, convenience, and a backyard you'll never want to leave. Showings begin immediately.
